# Power BI Analyst Insights\n\nGenerated by the analytical pipeline from the same Olist data used by the dashboard.\n\nThese are descriptive observations for Power BI storytelling. They do not establish causality, profitability, future performance, or current-market benchmarks.\n\n## 1. Revenue concentration\n\n**Headline:** Top 5 categories = 39.8% of revenue\n\n**Evidence:** Health Beauty leads the category ranking at 9.3% of merchandise revenue.\n\n**Power BI use:** Ranked bar chart, revenue-share KPI and category drill-through.\n\n## 2. Geographic concentration\n\n**Headline:** Top 3 states = 63.4% of revenue\n\n**Evidence:** SP leads state revenue at 5,163,867 across 41,125 orders.\n\n**Power BI use:** State ranking, matrix, conditional formatting and drill-through.\n\n## 3. Retention opportunity\n\n**Headline:** Repeat-customer rate = 3.04%\n\n**Evidence:** The observed customer base contains a small repeat-purchase population in this marketplace dataset.\n\n**Power BI use:** KPI card, RFM mix, segment revenue and customer-share comparison.\n\n## 4. Delivery and experience\n\n**Headline:** Late delivery = 6.8% of qualifying orders\n\n**Evidence:** 8+ day delays are 43.8% of late orders; late orders show lower average reviews than on-time orders.\n\n**Power BI use:** Delay-severity chart, review comparison, tooltips and state filtering.\n\n## 5. Freight intensity\n\n**Headline:** Freight = 16.6% of merchandise revenue\n\n**Evidence:** Observed freight value is R$2,241,126; this is a logistics metric, not profit.\n\n**Power BI use:** Freight-to-revenue KPI and category/state decomposition.\n\n## 6. Payment mix\n\n**Headline:** Credit card = 78.3% of payment value\n\n**Evidence:** Payment records are modeled separately to avoid one-to-many multiplication with order-item rows.\n\n**Power BI use:** Payment-mix visual with controlled fact-table relationships.\n
